additional_info.subject: ID0468357-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P8 170000895] Connector issue CRM:03056000821
additional_info.body:
Dear
Theo
,
Following your report and After reviewing the logs, as you can see in the screenshot  that the EV connected to DC2 stopped charging at 95%. After that, the EVSE performed a shutdown, which appears to be related to an issue on QA13–14. We  We also observed that the error subsequently disappeared.
We will continue to monitor the charger, and if the error appears again, we will plan an on-site check for QA13–14.
With best regards,
Younes Baroudi
eMobility Technical Support Team
